name: TanStack Query
tagline: Asynchronous state management and data fetching for web applications.
hook: A minimal guide linking contributor instructions, applying them to AI-assisted work, and limiting changes to one topic.
summary: TanStack Query's ten-line AGENTS.md points to the contributor guide and requires one topic per change. Contributors must understand and verify any generated code they touch.

techniques.title: Apply one contributor contract to human and assisted work
techniques.body: The file requires reading CONTRIBUTING.md before analysis or changes. It explicitly applies the same development, testing, pull-request, and changeset requirements to AI-assisted work.
techniques.quote:
Before analyzing or changing this repository, read and follow
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](./CONTRIBUTING.md). Its contribution, development, testing,
pull request, and changeset requirements apply to AI-assisted work as well as
human-authored work.

techniques.title: Pair narrow scope with responsibility for generated code
techniques.body: The final paragraph combines a one-topic change boundary with understanding and verifying generated code. It also directs the pull request description to the existing template.
techniques.quote:
Keep every change focused on one topic. Understand and verify all generated
code, run the required checks, and provide a concise pull request description
that follows the repository template.

steal: Apply shared contribution requirements to AI-assisted changes explicitly.
Keep each change focused on one topic.
Require understanding and verification of generated code.
